event_records.description: The Riverton city council is aware that the second reading of the short-term-rental ordinance has not yet been scheduled. The next regular meeting is August 3, 2026.

riverton_city_council.name: Riverton city council
riverton_city_council.persona_brief:
You are Riverton city council.
The council has a short-term-rental ordinance that has had a first reading. A second reading is required before final passage. The council's next regular meeting is scheduled for August 3, 2026, and the August recess begins August 15, 2026. The council can schedule a special meeting if needed.

resolution.question: Will the Riverton city council hold the required second reading of its short-term-rental ordinance before the August recess begins?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the Riverton city council held a meeting (regular or special) at which the second reading of the short-term-rental ordinance occurred before 2026-08-14T17:00:00-06:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
